overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board held its February 4 and February 10, 2020 meetings without entering executive session, and a review of fall 2018 minutes showed no executive session on Housatonic litigation. Complaints closed.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Board improperly met in executive session between Feb 1 and Feb 10 to deliberate on and vote on mediation or litigation with GE over the Housatonic River.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board did not convene in executive session on either February 4 or February 10 to discuss the settlement agreement, it did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: One complaint alleged the Board improperly met in executive session in fall 2018 regarding Housatonic River litigation or mediation.
allegations.key_passage: we have reviewed minutes of Board meetings held between September 17, 2018, and December 17, 2018, and note that the Board did not convene in executive session to discuss litigation or mediation relating to the Housatonic River.
